about: Reusable underscore themes for animated history explainers. A plan asset {"music_library": NAME} renders a theme once into the shared cache (<library>/music/) and every later film reuses it for free. Each is one steady mood, about 90 s, so a scene can take any part of it. Add a theme when a setting or era recurs; keep one-off moods as plan assets.

explainer-playful.prompt: Light comic explainer underscore. Pizzicato strings, bassoon and clarinet trading a cheeky motif, plucked double bass, light woodblock. 104 BPM, G major, curious and mischievous, sparse and uncluttered. Steady mood throughout, ending on a clean final chord.

mystery-1920s.prompt: Sly 1920s mystery underscore. Muted pizzicato strings, soft brushed snare, ticking woodblock, a low clarinet hinting at a secret. 96 BPM, D minor, curious and slightly suspicious, light and sparse. Steady mood throughout, ending on a soft unresolved chord.

dark-drone.prompt: Dark ominous drone underscore. Low sustained cello and double bass cluster, distant metallic hits, a slow heartbeat-like low drum every few seconds, cold and uneasy. Very sparse, no melody, around 60 BPM. Steady throughout, fading out at the end.

rising-question.prompt: Investigative tension underscore. Pulsing staccato low strings in eighth notes, ticking hi-hat, timpani rolls, a slow build in intensity that keeps growing without a big climax. 110 BPM, E minor, urgent but restrained, ending on a held note.

ragtime-america.prompt: Playful 1910s-1920s American ragtime underscore. Bouncy honky-tonk piano, pizzicato strings, light snare, tuba bass with slide trombone accents. 104 BPM, F major, cheerful, cheeky and a little smug. Steady mood throughout, ending on a clean final chord.

industrial-menace.prompt: Factory menace underscore. Rhythmic metallic clanks woven into low strings, a steady machine-like pulse, distant hiss, ominous brass swells. 90 BPM, C minor, industrial and threatening without being loud. Steady throughout, ending on a low hit.

lab-curiosity.prompt: Quirky science lab underscore. Plucked strings and celesta, marimba bubbles, a playful bass clarinet line, light glockenspiel sparkles. 100 BPM, A minor, inventive and slightly mad-scientist. Steady mood throughout, ending on a twinkling chord.

triumph-ironic.prompt: Mock-triumphant underscore. Pompous brass fanfare figures, snare rolls, cymbal swells, a slightly too-proud march feel, never epic or loud. 112 BPM, B-flat major, celebratory with a wink. Steady throughout, ending on a brassy final chord.

sincere-reflection.prompt: Sincere reflective underscore for a tragic or serious passage. Solo piano with a soft string pad, slow and simple, no percussion. 70 BPM, E-flat major, warm, respectful and calm. Steady throughout, ending softly.

modern-chiptune.prompt: Playful retro video-game underscore for a modern joke. Bouncy chiptune square-wave melody, simple arpeggios, light 8-bit drums. 120 BPM, C major, upbeat and silly. Steady throughout, ending on a clean final note.

cold-pulse.prompt: Cold modern investigative underscore for an animated explainer. Pulsing analog synth bass in steady eighth notes, soft ticking hi-hat, a glassy digital arpeggio, distant low sub hits every few bars. 100 BPM, A minor, clinical, tense and restrained, slowly building without a big climax, ending on a held low note.
